key_insight: A 1/L residual scaling rule supports learning-rate transfer across depth for constrained spectral optimizers while preserving feature learning.
engineering_relevance: For Scion, the analysis supports reusing learning rates across depth and width, potentially reducing tuning costs when scaling neural networks.
method: Derive scaling rules for Frank–Wolfe and projected non-Euclidean normalized steepest descent.
Analyze updates determined by linear minimization oracles.
Use 1/L residual scaling to support transfer while avoiding the kernel regime.
evidence_signal: Experiments with nanoGPT on FineWeb, DeiT on ImageNet, and MLP-Mixer on CIFAR-10 show depth-wise learning-rate transfer and feature learning with appropriately chosen residual scaling.
watch_item: Transfer depends on appropriate residual scaling; the abstract provides no quantitative effect sizes or guarantees beyond the analyzed setting.
paper_title: Learning Rate Transfer and Feature Learning Across Depth for Constrained Spectral Optimizers: Complete Scion
